michael_schumacher.name: Michael Schumacher
michael_schumacher.verdict: You don't just want to win — you want to build the whole team around how you win. Relentless, prepared, and utterly unwilling to give an inch.

ayrton_senna.name: Ayrton Senna
ayrton_senna.verdict: You drive on pure instinct and conviction. When you're in the zone nobody can touch you — and you'd rather crash than concede the corner.

alain_prost.name: Alain Prost
alain_prost.verdict: You win races by thinking, not thrashing. Why take a risk at lap 3 when you can simply be the last one standing at lap 60?

alonso.name: Fernando Alonso
alonso.verdict: You extract more from a bad situation than anyone should be able to. Patient, cunning, and always three moves ahead of the pit wall.

max_verstappen.name: Max Verstappen
max_verstappen.verdict: Uncompromising. You go for the gap whether or not it's still there, and you back yourself to make it work every single time.

hamilton.name: Lewis Hamilton
hamilton.verdict: You race on feel and you thrive when it gets messy. Chaos, rain, a safety car — that's when you find a lap nobody else had.

leclerc.name: Charles Leclerc
leclerc.verdict: Blistering on a single lap and completely open about how much it hurts when it goes wrong. Heart permanently on the sleeve.

norris.name: Lando Norris
norris.verdict: Seriously quick and your own harshest critic. You feel every mistake twice — once in the car, once on the radio afterwards.

piastri.name: Oscar Piastri
piastri.verdict: Ice in the veins. No drama, no theatrics, no wasted energy — just a clinical job done to the tenth, every single weekend.

russell.name: George Russell
russell.verdict: Cerebral and calculating. You read the race like a chess board and you're already arguing the strategy before the engineer finishes talking.

nico_rosberg.name: Nico Rosberg
nico_rosberg.verdict: You out-prepare people. Where others rely on raw talent, you win on data, detail and sheer refusal to be out-worked.

daniel_ricciardo.name: Daniel Ricciardo
daniel_ricciardo.verdict: You brake later than anyone thinks is survivable, pull off the lunge from a mile back, then laugh about it on the podium.

sebastian_vettel.name: Sebastian Vettel
sebastian_vettel.verdict: You'd rather win it in qualifying than fight for it on lap one. Build the perfect lap, build the perfect car around it, then do it again next winter.

kimi_raikkonen.name: Kimi Räikkönen
kimi_raikkonen.verdict: Nothing gets a reaction out of you — not the radio, not the media, not the car trying to kill you. You just drive, exactly as fast as you feel like it.

nigel_mansell.name: Nigel Mansell
nigel_mansell.verdict: Every lap is personal. You'll out-brake the field, wear your grievances on your sleeve, and take the fight to the last corner of the last lap, every single time.

niki_lauda.name: Niki Lauda
niki_lauda.verdict: You calculate the risk before you take it, and when the number doesn't add up, you're the one driver willing to say so out loud and pull into the pits.
